description: The Philippine Statistics Authority publishes the 2020 Census of Population and Housing in OpenSTAT, a PxWeb database with an open API. Its 2020 folder has tables on occupied housing units by type of building, by number of floors from one to eleven or more, and by floor area and number of occupants, plus households by tenure; a housing folder adds occupied housing units by construction materials of the outer walls and roof. Each table goes down to province and highly urbanized city, with 135 geographic values. Coverage is national: the API returned 25,191,610 occupied housing units in 2020, of which 19,990,317 had one floor, 4,261,607 two floors and 142,133 eleven floors or more. Format and access: free, no registration; the PxWeb API returns CSV, JSON or PX for a JSON query. The PSA main website returned a Cloudflare challenge (HTTP 403) from the cloud, so only OpenSTAT was read. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: no water, sanitation or electricity variables in the 2020 census tables in OpenSTAT; the 2024 census folder holds population and household counts by barangay only. Simulation uses: storey counts, building type and wall and roof materials by province for typhoon, flood and earthquake exposure models. Related records: the Philippines pre-disaster indicators and the typhoon Haima house damage priority index.
